<script setup lang="ts">
import { PopoverRoot } from 'reka-ui';
import { toRef } from 'vue';
import { providePopoverPlacement } from './context.js';
import type { Placement } from './placement.js';

// Use `v-model:open` to control it from outside.
const { placement = 'bottom' } = defineProps<{ placement?: Placement }>();
const open = defineModel<boolean>('open', { default: false });
providePopoverPlacement(toRef(() => placement));
</script>

<template>
	<PopoverRoot v-model:open="open">
		<slot />
	</PopoverRoot>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { PopoverTrigger } from 'reka-ui';
import { Button, type ButtonSize, type ButtonVariant } from '../button/index.js';

// Renders our Button, so it takes the same variant and size props.
const { variant = 'outline', size } = defineProps<{ variant?: ButtonVariant; size?: ButtonSize }>();
</script>

<template>
	<PopoverTrigger as-child>
		<Button :variant="variant" :size="size"><slot /></Button>
	</PopoverTrigger>
</template>
